# InstaDownloader — free social media video downloader

> InstaDownloader is a free web tool that lets users download videos, reels, posts and stories from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest and X without signup, login or watermark (where platform terms permit).

## Tools
- [Instagram Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/instagram): Download Instagram reels, posts, stories, IGTV and photos in HD.
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/instagram-reels-downloader): Save Instagram Reels in HD.
- [YouTube Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/yt): Download YouTube videos in HD, convert to MP3.
- [YouTube Shorts Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/youtube-shorts-downloader): Save YouTube Shorts as MP4 or MP3.
- [TikTok Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/tiktok): Download TikTok videos in HD with audio preserved.
- [Facebook Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/facebook): Save Facebook videos and reels in HD.
- [Pinterest Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/pinterest): Download Pinterest video pins and images in HD.
- [X Downloader](https://instadownloader.app/x): Save videos and GIFs from X (formerly Twitter).
